requester_boundary: This is an agent-owned study of the independently chosen concept. These gates are not requester-owned visual assertions, candidate-adoption gates, or proof of general Clockpunk completeness.

reference.scope: face and hair appearance guidance only
reference.gate: The face/hair resemble the supplied reference at the rendered scale; no real identity, biography or age claim.

assessment_rule: For every multi-component relation, all named components and the stated connection must be visible together. partial or unobservable is not a pass; record pixel evidence separately from prompt/audit status.

gates.relation: An exposed flat spiral mainspring sits in a winding drum whose arbor pinion visibly meshes with the broad brass gear.
gates.purpose: Mechanical power source and first transmission, beyond ornamental gears.

gates.relation: The gear axle carries a visible cam whose raised nose contacts a pivoted lever; the opposite lever end meets the water-valve stem.
gates.purpose: Output actuation connects clockwork to practical water control.

gates.relation: A raised reservoir is connected by one copper feed tube through the valve to a downstream spout; the spout stream lands in the seed tray and darkens the landing soil.
gates.purpose: Complete working-medium path and visible result.

gates.relation: One woman has a right hand on the near-side winding key and a left hand on the tray rim, each traceable through its own forearm, with the gear mesh clear.
gates.purpose: Embodied practical use with assessable spatial contact.

gates.relation: Her downward gaze and the frame connect face, open clockwork assembly and the watered seedling, inside a crafted preindustrial courtyard setting.
gates.purpose: The image reads as inhabited Clockpunk care rather than detached mechanism illustration.
